title: Reel: the six finished signature kills at 32 px/m, real time, 6 s each
note: Rocket gib, hand cannon blowback, flamethrower char, electro X-ray, katana split, plasma hole; arena kill lab, labelled. At 32 px/m the plasma hole is the weakest read.

title: Katana signature kill: the body cut in two, 64 px/m slow close-up (0.4x)
note: Rivet lunges, one diagonal slash (cream streak), the cop's own rig splits into two clipped halves that slide apart on red smears, raw red edge on each cut, blood fans along the cut. Lab driver until melee weapons are live.

title: Katana signature kill, real time at 32 px/m (lab line, 6 kills)
note: The game zoom. Halves 3-3.8 m/s, drag 2.6, hit-stop 6 ticks.

title: Katana signature kill on the city proving block (48 px/m)

title: Katana kill, 6 frames from the slash to the halves at rest (64 px/m)

title: Electro gun signature kill: X-ray strobe, 64 px/m slow close-up 0.4x
note: --rigs --sig-gun=electro_gun --sig-lab. The bolt locks the victim in a stiff convulsion; every 5 ticks the body blinks out and his X-ray skeleton (weapon-art sticker, 1.3 m) shows inside cream ink arcs; then he drops stiff along the shot with collar smoke. No blood. The other arcs on the crowd are gunplay's chain stun.

title: Flamethrower signature kill (fire death chars), 64 px/m slow close-up 0.4x
note: Arena hub, --rigs --sig-gun=flamethrower --sig-lab. A guard set ablaze flails in a tethered panic run (gunplay burn + human-reactions flail), the burn kills him: his own rig turns to a charcoal print (kill_char shader), smokes, then crumbles into ash flakes drifting downwind onto an ash heap over a soot scorch. No blood: the standard death pool and corpse stains are vetoed under a signature kill. Small cream flash 2 ticks, hit-stop 2.

title: Rocket signature kill, 64 px/m slow close-up (0.4x)
note: Arena hub, --rigs --sig-gun=rocket_launcher --sig-lab. The cop is blown into its own six rig parts (head+cap, torso, arms, legs) that spin, bounce and slide with blood stumps and drag smears; cream ink flash 4 ticks, 4-tick hit-stop, scorch star, red spray fan. The straight red rods are this kill's v1 drag smears (since redrawn as blotchy wet streaks, commit after edcc87e); the dark wedge near the body is the standard d5-combat pool still playing under the kill.
